title: HeyGen vs an AI Ad Agency for Meta Ads: Which Fits Better
summary: HeyGen vs an AI ad agency for Meta ads: compare per-video cost, who checks each ad, campaign ownership and Meta's AI labels to pick the right route.
body_markdown:
## When HeyGen is the better buy


Choose HeyGen when your team already writes, films or approves its own videos, has someone who runs Ads Manager, and wants a low monthly tool cost for presenter-led content. Its Creator plan is a small monthly commitment, and its free plan allows 3 watermarked videos a month (as of October 2026). The tradeoff is that production time stays with your team. Our[HeyGen pricing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/heygen-pricing) maps credits to finished videos.


## Knowlify: when a managed AI ad agency is the better buy for Meta


Knowlify is the better buy when producing approved ads keeps consuming your week, when nobody owns the test plan, or when you want campaign ownership under a defined scope. It makes about 25 finished ads a week, so your supply of new concepts does not depend on your team's hours. Its first batch lands on day 5, a person checks every ad before delivery, and it covers three formats (AI UGC, 3D and stylized character animation, AI commercials) where HeyGen covers presenter video.


You can take end-to-end Meta campaign management, or creative only if you already have a media buyer. Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card. Where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month. On creative-only plans, if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). For the managed route's scope, see our[Meta ads service](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency) .


When to pick another option: Knowlify does not supply real human creators, post from creator accounts, or run TikTok, LinkedIn, Google or YouTube ads. Pick a creator route if partnership ads or real customers are essential to the offer.


## How do you decide with one pilot?


Give both routes the same offer, the same approved claims and the same Meta test budget. Track hours to a finished file, revision rounds, approvals and the number of accepted ads. Compare the cost of accepted ads, not plan prices. A $29 monthly plan does not include the scripting, rendering, editing and review you still do, and a managed quote covers only the scope you agree to, so read that scope line by line. For a side-by-side view of the responsibility split, see[Knowlify versus HeyGen](https://knowlify.com/articles/knowlify-vs-heygen) .


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for Meta video ads when you want finished ads delivered for approval and optional campaign management.
- HeyGen is avatar software your team runs; its per-minute cost rises with re-renders and review time.
- Compare the campaign role of each option, not only the monthly price.
- Run one pilot with the same offer and claims, and judge the cost of accepted ads.


## FAQ


### What is the best option, HeyGen or an AI ad agency, for Meta ads?


Knowlify is our top pick for most teams that want finished Meta video ads without building a production process, since it makes about 25 finished ads a week, a person checks every one, and it can run campaigns or deliver creative only. HeyGen is the better buy when your team will create, render and check its own presenter videos. Decide by who will do the work each week.


### How much does HeyGen cost per finished ad?


HeyGen's Creator plan lists $29 a month billed monthly with 600 credits. An Avatar IV video uses 31 credits a minute, which its pricing table puts at about $1.50 per minute. Re-renders consume more credits, and the time to script, check and edit each ad is not in the plan price.


### Does Knowlify run Meta campaigns?


Knowlify offers end-to-end Meta campaign management, or creative only for teams that already have a media buyer. Pricing is a custom quote with no public rate card. Ask for the campaign scope in writing, including who sets the test plan and who reports results.


### Will Meta label AI-made ads?


Meta labels ads created or significantly edited with its own generative tools when a photorealistic AI-generated person appears. It says it will detect third-party AI-edited ads and show an "AI info" label, but its post does not say third-party detection is live yet. Keep a record of which tool made each presenter.


### Can I move from HeyGen to a managed service without losing my work?


Scripts, briefs and approved exports are normally yours to hand to a new provider. Check HeyGen's export and reuse terms for avatars, voices and projects before you assume they move with you. Then have the new provider rebuild one approved ad to confirm the process works before you rely on it.
